notes.subject: ol man i kilim
notes.rationale: חלליכם is 'your pierced ones' — slain men, not merely wounded

notes.subject: חמניכם
notes.rationale: חמן sun-pillar is rare; rendered literally as 'stones of the sun'

notes.subject: גלול
notes.rationale: Hebrew pun: גלול from 'round log', contemptuous term for idols — kept as 'gilgul'

translation: Ol alter bilong yupela bai i bagarap, ol ston bilong san bilong yupela bai i bruk, na bai mi pundaunim ol man bilong yupela ol i bin kilim i go LONG TOK PISIN long pes bilong ol gilgul bilong yupela.

tokens.gloss: ol ston bilong san bilong yupela
ol man bilong yupela ol i bin kilim
